name: When do I need professional help for water on the floor from a leak?

mainEntity.name: When do I need professional help for water on the floor from a leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional help is needed when the water covers a large area, the source of the leak is unknown, the water has been present for more than 24-48 hours, or if you suspect hidden moisture or structural damage. Extensive water intrusion can lead to mold growth, compromise building materials, and create health hazards. A professional restoration company has specialized equipment to detect hidden moisture, dry affected areas thoroughly, and prevent secondary damage that DIY methods often miss. Early intervention minimizes long-term costs and damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seek professional help if the area is large, the source is unknown, water has been present over 24-48 hours, or if you suspect hidden damage or mold.
